notes: Rule 102: where a Greek article governs the phrase, the article takes the determiner together with the nominal the ASV supplies, headed on the nominal, and the substantival adjective keeps its own bare word; any case preposition rides with the article under rule 21. The verse had read the articular τῷ τυφλῷ the anarthrous way that rule 17 reserves for a phrase no article governs, which is the reading rule 102 records JAS.1.11 correcting.
